# Top enrichment/genes
```{r}
i<-gsea_bp%>%filter(str_detect(ct,"En"))%>%
  separate_rows(core_enrichment,sep = '/')%>%
  distinct(ct,core_enrichment)
colnames(i)[2]<-"gene"
subdeg<-deg%>%inner_join(i)
subdeg<-avgs%>%group_by(ct)%>%
  filter(`LA-`>quantile(`LA-`,.95)|`LA+`>quantile(`LA+`,.95))%>%#0.5 for Th2 cells
  inner_join(subdeg)
subdeg<-subdeg%>%slice_max(abs(avg_log2FC),n=20)
subdeg<-gsea_bp%>%separate_rows(core_enrichment,sep = '/')%>%
  mutate(gene=core_enrichment)%>%select(Description,NES,gene,ct)%>%
  right_join(subdeg,by=c("ct","gene"))
subdeg<-subdeg%>%mutate(diff=`LA+`-`LA-`)%>%
  filter((avg_log2FC>0&diff>0&NES>0)|(avg_log2FC<0&diff<0&NES<0))%>%
  select(-c(p_val,pct.1,pct.2,NES))%>%group_by(ct,gene)%>%
  mutate(Description=paste(sort(unique(Description)),collapse = ','))%>%distinct()
#chose fro subdeg
enepgenes<-c("AEBP1","MMP2","LRP1","FN1","SFRP2","CD109")
ensgenes<-c("IGFBP2","ANGPTL7","ADH1B","WNT5A","CXCL13")
enepaths<-c("response to estradiol",
            "muscle cell migration",
            "cell-matrix adhesion",
            "Wnt signaling pathway",
            "epithelial cell proliferation")
enspaths<-c("leukocyte cell-cell adhesion",
            "wound healing",
            "alcohol metabolic process",
            "response to type II interferon",
            "endothelial cell proliferation")
pB<-gsea_bp%>%filter(Description%in%enepaths&ct=="EnEpi cells")%>%
    arrange(NES)%>%mutate(Description=factor(Description,
                                             levels = unique(Description)))%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=NES,y=Description,col=NES,size=p.adjust))+geom_point()+
    scale_color_gradient2(low="#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
    scale_size(range=c(3,5))+theme_classic()+theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
pB1<-gsea_bp%>%filter(Description%in%enspaths&ct=="EnS cells")%>%
    arrange(NES)%>%mutate(Description=factor(Description,
                                             levels = unique(Description)))%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=NES,y=Description,col=NES,size=p.adjust))+geom_point()+
    scale_color_gradient2(low="#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
    scale_size(range=c(3,5))+theme_classic()+theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

# ARID5B
```{r}
scDEG<-read_csv("docs/has_laDEG-ct100-MAST.tsv",skip = 1)
temp<-scDEG%>%filter(cell_type=="EnS cells")%>%
  mutate(STATUS=case_when(avg_log2FC<=-1&p_val_adj<0.05~"Low",
                          avg_log2FC>=1&p_val_adj<0.05~"Up",
                          TRUE~"Not.Sig"))
pF<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=avg_log2FC,y=-log10(p_val_adj),col=STATUS))+
  geom_point()+geom_text_repel(data=temp%>%filter(STATUS!="Not.Sig")
                               %>%group_by(STATUS)%>%
                                 slice_min(p_val_adj,n = 3),
                               aes(label=gene),show.legend = F)+
  theme_classic()+theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkgreen", "grey", "red"))   

```

```{r}
#degsc<-read_csv("docs/has_laDEG-ct100-MAST.tsv",skip=1)
i<-deg%>%filter(avg_log2FC>=.3)%>%distinct(gene,ct)#ideal LFC threshold
temp<-pairs%>%inner_join(i,by=c("ligand"="gene","source"="ct"))
temp<-temp%>%inner_join(i,by=c("receptor"="gene","target"="ct"))
temp<-temp%>%pivot_wider(names_from = has_LA,values_from = prob)%>%
  filter(`LA+`>`LA-`|is.na(`LA-`))%>%pivot_longer(`LA+`:`LA-`,names_to = "has_LA",values_to = "prob")
temp%>%filter(str_detect(interaction_name_2,"COL",negate=T))%>%ggplot(aes(y=paste0(source,' - ',target),x=has_LA,col=prob))+geom_point()+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,vjust = 1,hjust = 1))+facet_wrap(~interaction_name_2,scales="free",space="free_y",ncol=2)+scale_color_viridis_c(option = "H")

i<-c("Prostaglandin","VISFATIN","OSM","IFN-II","VEGF","CXCL")
i<-pairs%>%filter(pathway_name%in%i)%>%
  distinct(ligand,receptor,pathway_name)
i<-i%>%mutate(interaction=1:nrow(i))%>%
  pivot_longer(1:2,names_to = "type",values_to = "gene")%>%
  separate_rows(gene,sep = "-|_")%>%
  mutate(interaction=paste(pathway_name,interaction))

temp<-DotPlot(subset(sc,subset=has_LA=="LA+"),
              group.by = "nosub",features = unique(i$gene))
temp1<-DotPlot(subset(sc,subset=has_LA=="LA-"),
               group.by = "nosub",features = unique(i$gene))
temp<-temp$data%>%mutate(has_LA="LA+")
temp<-temp1$data%>%mutate(has_LA="LA-")%>%bind_rows(temp)
temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=has_LA,y=id,col=avg.exp,size=pct.exp))+geom_point()+
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "H")+facet_grid(~features.plot)

pE<-plotGeneExpression(cc_res[[1]], signaling = "IFN-II", split.by = "datasets", type = "violin",color.use = c("#f46d43","#8DB600"))
```

## Do proteins match with transcritps?
```{r}
files<-list.files()
files<-files[str_detect(files,"dom_marke")]
domMarkers<-lapply(files,read_csv)
names(domMarkers)<-str_remove(files,"_dom.+")
domMarkers<-lapply(names(domMarkers),function(x) domMarkers[[x]]%>%mutate(ct=x))%>%bind_rows()
i<-as.data.frame(cbind(symbol=c("TNFRSF9","TNFRSF18","RELA"),gene=c("4-1BB","GITR","NF-kB p65")))
domMarkers%>%filter(cluster=="g3")%>%inner_join(i)%>%ggplot(aes(x=gene,y=ct,col=avg_log2FC,size = p_val))+geom_point()+geom_point(data=domMarkers%>%filter(cluster=="g3"&p_val_adj<0.05)%>%inner_join(i),col="black",shape=1,stroke=1.5)+scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue",mid = "white",high = "red")+scale_size(range=c(5,.1))+facet_grid(~symbol,scales="free",space="free")+theme_minimal()+ggtitle("CosMx")
```

## Markers
```{r}
temp<-metadata%>%filter(dom_nEndoh1_75=="6")
temp<-split(temp,by = "Run_Tissue_name")
get_expre<-function(sample_name){
  fname<-paste0("docs/",sample_name,"asinh.csv")
  mat<-data.table::fread(fname)
  mat<-mat%>%as.data.frame()%>%column_to_rownames("probe")
  mat<-mat[,temp[[sample_name]]$cell_id]
  colnames(mat)<-paste0(sample_name,colnames(mat))
  return(mat)}
dom_mat<-lapply(names(temp),function(x) get_expre(x))
dom_mat<-dom_mat%>%bind_cols()


#could change for deg lfc instead
temp<-dom_mat%>%group_by(Class,Run_Tissue_name,merged_corrected)%>%summarise(across(`4-1BB`:`pan-RAS`,mean))
temp1<-temp%>%ungroup()%>%select(`4-1BB`:`pan-RAS`)%>%scale()
temp1<-temp%>%select(Class:merged_corrected)%>%bind_cols(temp1)
temp1<-temp1%>%pivot_longer(`4-1BB`:`pan-RAS`,names_to = "probe",values_to = "scaled")%>%group_by(Class,merged_corrected,probe)%>%summarise(mean_scaled=mean(scaled))%>%pivot_wider(names_from = Class,values_from = mean_scaled)
temp1<-temp1%>%filter(str_detect(merged_corrected,"theli|Mesen|NK|Plas",negate = T))

markers<-c("CD56","CD138","CD68","CD45","CD4","CD3","FABP4","CD8",
           "Channel-PanCK","Fibronectin","SMA","CD31","CD34","EpCAM")
weird <- scales::trans_new("signed",
                           transform=function(x) ifelse(x>0,
                                                        atan(x),
                                                        sign(x)*sqrt(abs(x))),
                           inverse=function(x) round(atan(x),1))

weird1 <- scales::trans_new("asin_like",
                           transform=function(x) ifelse(x<=1,
                                                        asin(sqrt(x)),
                                                        asinh(sqrt(x))),
                           inverse=function(x) round(sin(x)**2,1))


pD<-temp1%>%filter(!probe%in%markers)%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=`Peritoneal endometriosis`,y=`Eutopic endometrium`,col=merged_corrected))+
    geom_point()+
    geom_text_repel(data = temp1%>%
                        filter(`Peritoneal endometriosis`<=-.5&`Eutopic endometrium`>.5&!probe%in%markers)%>%
                        group_by(merged_corrected)%>%
                        slice_min(`Peritoneal endometriosis`,n=10)%>%
                        slice_max(`Eutopic endometrium`,n=5),
                    aes(x=`Peritoneal endometriosis`,y=`Eutopic endometrium`,label=probe),
                    show.legend = F)+scale_color_manual(values = cellcols)+
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)+theme(legend.position = "none")+
    facet_wrap(~merged_corrected)+
    scale_x_continuous(transform = weird,breaks = c(-.5,0,.5))+
    scale_y_continuous(transform = weird1,breaks = c(0,.5,1,1.5,2))

```


## Sc dotplots
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(readxl)

sc<-readRDS("data/fixed_annotated_aux.seurat.rds")
sc<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$Class%in%c("Eutopic endometrium","Peritoneal endometriosis")&
                            !is.na(sc$Final_Immune_Cluster_ID)))
sc@meta.data<-sc@meta.data%>%
  mutate(harmonized_major_cell_type=ifelse(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type=="Early Exhausted CD8 T-cells (2)",
                                           "T cells",harmonized_major_cell_type),
         has_LA=case_when(LA_per_Sample>0~"LA+",
                          LA_per_Sample==0~"LA-",
                          TRUE~Class))

tcells<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$harmonized_major_cell_type=="T cells"))
signatures<-read_excel("../../Downloads/41591_2023_2371_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx",sheet = 5,skip = 1)
signatures<-signatures%>%
  mutate(dummy="lala")%>%
  pivot_longer(-dummy,names_to = "signature",values_to = "gene")%>%
  drop_na()
signatures<-split(signatures,f = signatures$signature)%>%
  lapply(function(x) x$gene)
signatures<-lapply(signatures, function(x) x[x%in%rownames(tcells)])

tcells <- AddModuleScore(stcellsc,features = signatures)
colnames(tcells@meta.data)[173:191]<-str_replace_all(names(signatures)," ","_")
```
